quests.title: Beneath the Lunar Sea

dialogue.t: No idea! Paimon's never heard that name before.
But that doesn't matter. According to Paimon's super-sharp guide intuition, a place like this has gotta be stuffed with treasure!
Come on, let's go find out!
We made it inside... Wow, the tree is really beautiful!
Paimon didn't think there'd be a place like this hidden under the lunar sea. What do you think they did here? Let's take a look around!

quests.description: In the lunar sea, a group of jellyfish gathers near a cave. Perhaps something waits for you there…
